blocks.heading: A Foam Sheet That Does Two Jobs Well
blocks.html:
EVA foam is a closed-cell foam sheeting that garment manufacturers use in two distinct ways — as a padding and structure component built into a finished garment, and as a protective insert that keeps goods from shifting or getting crushed in transit. We supply it as sheets or rolls, cut to the thickness and firmness the application calls for.

Because the same base material serves both roles, buying houses that need padding inserts for one order and packaging inserts for another can source both from a single supplier instead of managing two separate vendors.

blocks.heading: EVA Foam FAQs
blocks.intro: Have a specification question that isn't covered here? Ask us directly.

items.a: We supply EVA foam across a range of thicknesses and densities, from thin soft-hand padding to firmer structured grades. Share your application and we'll recommend the closest match, then confirm with a sample.

items.q: Can EVA foam be die-cut to a custom shape?
items.a: Yes. EVA foam cuts cleanly and holds a die-cut edge well, which makes it suitable for repeat-pattern components such as padding pieces or packaging inserts cut to a supplied pattern or die.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: Minimum quantities depend on thickness, density and whether the foam is cut sheets or rolls. Send your requirement through our contact form and we'll confirm feasible order sizes and lead time.

items.q: Is the foam suitable for both garment padding and packaging use?
items.a: Yes. The same base material works for both — softer, thinner grades typically go into garment padding and structure inserts, while firmer or thicker cuts are more commonly used as protective packaging inserts. We'll help you pick the right grade for each use.

blocks.heading: Need EVA Foam To A Specific Thickness Or Density?
blocks.text: Tell us the application — garment padding or packaging insert — and your quantity. We'll confirm specification, pricing and lead time within one business day.
